response.sql: WITH statuses AS (SELECT COALESCE(brokrepstat, 'NULL') AS status, AVG(modelconf) AS avg_conf FROM compliancecase WHERE modelconf IS NOT NULL GROUP BY COALESCE(brokrepstat, 'NULL')), overall AS (SELECT AVG(modelconf) AS overall_avg FROM compliancecase WHERE modelconf IS NOT NULL), above_avg AS (SELECT s.status, s.avg_conf FROM statuses s, overall o WHERE s.avg_conf > o.overall_avg), mean_above AS (SELECT AVG(avg_conf) AS mean_of_above FROM above_avg) SELECT aa.status, aa.avg_conf, aa.avg_conf - o.overall_avg, aa.avg_conf / m.mean_of_above FROM above_avg aa, overall o, mean_above m WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND m.mean_of_above IS NOT NULL ORDER BY aa.status
